_meta.purpose: Starter set of pharmacogenomic + clinically actionable variants for v0.2. Source: ClinVar + PharmGKB + CPIC guidelines (all public databases). NOT exhaustive — represents the highest-impact, well-validated variants where 23andMe-style genotype data is sufficient for clinical action.
_meta.disclaimer: Variant interpretation requires confirmation in a CLIA-certified lab. AdelIA flags potential variants for clinician discussion — NOT a diagnostic test.

fields.alleles: List of alleles where the risk applies

variants.phenotype: CYP2C19 *2 — reduced clopidogrel activation
variants.actionability: Carriers may have reduced clopidogrel antiplatelet effect — consider alternative (ticagrelor, prasugrel) for ACS/PCI

variants.phenotype: CYP2C9 *2 — slower warfarin metabolism
variants.actionability: Warfarin requires reduced starting dose (~20-30%); use IWPC algorithm for dosing

variants.phenotype: Increased warfarin sensitivity
variants.actionability: Reduce warfarin starting dose; use IWPC algorithm

variants.phenotype: CYP2D6 *4 — poor metabolizer of codeine/tramadol
variants.actionability: Codeine inactive at standard dose → analgesia failure. Avoid codeine. Tramadol may also be ineffective.

variants.phenotype: SLCO1B1 *5 — increased simvastatin myopathy risk
variants.actionability: Avoid simvastatin > 40mg in homozygotes; consider rosuvastatin/atorvastatin

variants.phenotype: P-glycoprotein efflux pump variant — altered drug levels
variants.actionability: Discussion-worthy with prescriber for substrates (digoxin, dabigatran)

variants.phenotype: CYP2C9 *3 — slower warfarin metabolism
variants.actionability: Similar to *2 — reduce warfarin starting dose substantially

variants.phenotype: APOE ε4 — increased Alzheimer disease risk
variants.actionability: Lifestyle interventions evidence-based for risk reduction; not deterministic. Genetic counseling recommended before testing children.

variants.phenotype: APOE ε2 — protective against late-onset AD; increased type III hyperlipoproteinemia risk in homozygotes
variants.actionability: Lipid panel monitoring; consider if dyslipidemia hard to control

variants.phenotype: MTHFR C677T — mildly elevated homocysteine in homozygotes
variants.actionability: Folate supplementation may reduce homocysteine; clinical impact debated. Do NOT treat based on genotype alone — measure homocysteine first.

variants.phenotype: Factor V Leiden — increased venous thromboembolism risk
variants.actionability: Increased VTE risk (3-5x heterozygous, 10x homozygous). Caution with estrogen contraceptives, post-surgery prophylaxis discussion. Not anticoagulation alone based on carrier status.

variants.phenotype: Prothrombin G20210A — increased VTE risk
variants.actionability: Similar VTE counseling as Factor V Leiden. Heterozygotes ~3x risk; homozygotes rare and higher

variants.phenotype: DRD2 TaqI A1 — reduced dopamine D2 receptor density (debated clinical significance)
variants.actionability: Lifestyle/addiction risk awareness; not actionable on its own

variants.phenotype: TNF-α -308 G>A — altered inflammatory response
variants.actionability: Discussion-worthy in autoimmune contexts; clinical action limited

variants.phenotype: FTO variant — small (~3kg) BMI increase in homozygotes
variants.actionability: Lifestyle counseling; effect modifiable by diet/exercise

variants.phenotype: TCF7L2 — strongest common variant for type 2 diabetes risk
variants.actionability: Lifestyle intervention more effective in carriers (DPP study); enhanced T2D screening

variants.phenotype: HFE H63D — mild iron overload risk; C282Y (rs1800562) more severe
variants.actionability: Iron studies (ferritin, transferrin saturation) periodically; treat only if biochemical iron overload

variants.phenotype: HFE C282Y — hereditary hemochromatosis risk allele
variants.actionability: Homozygotes (C282Y/C282Y) — annual iron studies; phlebotomy if ferritin elevated. Heterozygotes generally asymptomatic.

variants.phenotype: MTHFR A1298C — milder than C677T
variants.actionability: Same as C677T — measure homocysteine if relevant

variants.phenotype: CFTR ΔF508 — most common cystic fibrosis-causing mutation
variants.actionability: Heterozygous carriers asymptomatic but offspring risk if partner also carrier. Genetic counseling pre-conception recommended.
